selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Shows policy creation, live zero values for all/default/enp1s0/lo, persistent file contents, and identical values after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 7223d5b7-fa56-4ff3-acee-959a5cf5f146; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is d2934f86-6420-4d28-be55-76e767b21005. System state, NetworkManager, IPv4 addressing, routing, reachability, and hardened sysctls all recovered.

commands.command:
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s
' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"; printf 'runtime_sysctls
'; sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route; printf 'network_health
'; ip -4 -brief address; ip -4 route; systemctl is-system-running --wait 2>/dev/null || systemctl is-system-running; systemctl is-active NetworkManager 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command: for i in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${i##*/}; printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s\n' "$n" "$(cat "$i/accept_redirects")" "$(cat "$i/accept_source_route")"; done

enp1s0 redirects=1 source_route=0
lo redirects=1 source_route=0

commands.command:
umask 022; tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects and source-routed packets.
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_source_route = 0
ANTRIEB_EOF
/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-sysctl --prefix=/net/ipv4/conf

printf 'persistent_file
'; cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf; printf 'runtime_all_interfaces
'; for i in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do n=${i##*/}; printf '%s redirects=%s source_route=%s
' "$n" "$(cat "$i/accept_redirects")" "$(cat "$i/accept_source_route")"; done; printf 'system_health
'; systemctl is-system-running; systemctl is-active NetworkManager; ip -4 -brief address; ip -4 route
